WITH g AS (SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, s.statsbomb_xg, e.minute, s.shot_type,
 CASE WHEN m.home_team_id=e.team_id THEN ta.team_name ELSE th.team_name END AS adversaire
FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id=s.event_id
JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id=e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id=e.team_id
JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id=e.match_id JOIN sb.teams th ON th.team_id=m.home_team_id JOIN sb.teams ta ON ta.team_id=m.away_team_id
WHERE s.outcome='Goal' AND e.period<>5)
SELECT * FROM g WHERE statsbomb_xg=(SELECT min(statsbomb_xg) FROM g)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_coup_franc_direct FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e USING(event_id) WHERE s.shot_type='Free Kick' AND s.outcome='Goal' AND e.period<>5

SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_prolongations
FROM sb.events e
LEFT JOIN sb.shots s ON s.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE e.period IN (3, 4)
  AND ((e.type = 'Shot' AND s.outcome = 'Goal') OR e.type = 'Own Goal Against')
SELECT count(*) AS buts_de_la_tete FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id=s.event_id WHERE s.outcome='Goal' AND s.body_part='Head' AND e.period<>5
SELECT SUM(home_score + away_score) AS buts, COUNT(*) AS matchs FROM sb.matches

WITH x AS (SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, SUM(s.statsbomb_xg) AS xg_cumule, COUNT(*) AS tirs
FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id=s.event_id
JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id=e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id=e.team_id
WHERE e.period<>5 GROUP BY p.player_name, t.team_name),
r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY xg_cumule DESC) rang FROM x)
SELECT rang, player_name, team_name, xg_cumule, tirs FROM r WHERE rang<=5 ORDER BY rang

WITH mj AS (
  SELECT team_id, count(*) AS matchs FROM (
    SELECT home_team_id AS team_id FROM sb.matches UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id FROM sb.matches) t GROUP BY team_id),
f AS (
  SELECT team_id, count(*) AS fautes FROM sb.events WHERE type='Foul Committed' AND period<>5 GROUP BY team_id),
r AS (
  SELECT t.team_name, coalesce(f.fautes,0) AS fautes, mj.matchs, coalesce(f.fautes,0)::numeric/mj.matchs AS fautes_par_match,
  rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(f.fautes,0)::numeric/mj.matchs DESC) AS rg
  FROM mj JOIN sb.teams t USING(team_id) LEFT JOIN f USING(team_id))
SELECT team_name, fautes, matchs, fautes_par_match FROM r WHERE rg=1 ORDER BY fautes_par_match DESC

SELECT p.player_name AS joueur, t.team_name AS equipe, th.team_name || ' - ' || ta.team_name AS match, m.stage, m.match_date, e.minute,
 COALESCE(e.details->'foul_committed'->'card'->>'name', e.details->'bad_behaviour'->'card'->>'name') AS carton
FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id=e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id=e.team_id
JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id=e.match_id JOIN sb.teams th ON th.team_id=m.home_team_id JOIN sb.teams ta ON ta.team_id=m.away_team_id
WHERE e.type IN ('Foul Committed','Bad Behaviour')
 AND COALESCE(e.details->'foul_committed'->'card'->>'name', e.details->'bad_behaviour'->'card'->>'name') IN ('Red Card','Second Yellow')
ORDER BY m.match_date, e.minute
SELECT t.team_name, count(*) AS nb_matchs FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id IN (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) WHERE t.team_name = 'Croatia' GROUP BY t.team_name

WITH g AS (SELECT e.player_id, count(*) AS buts FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY e.player_id)
SELECT p.player_name, g.buts FROM g JOIN sb.players p USING (player_id) WHERE g.buts = (SELECT max(buts) FROM g)

WITH t AS (SELECT tm.team_name, count(*) AS passes_tentees, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.outcome IS NULL) AS passes_reussies, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.outcome IS NULL)::numeric/count(*) AS taux
FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id=p.event_id JOIN sb.teams tm ON tm.team_id=e.team_id
WHERE e.period<>5 GROUP BY tm.team_name)
SELECT * FROM t WHERE taux = (SELECT max(taux) FROM t)

WITH t AS (SELECT home_team_id team_id, away_score ga FROM sb.matches UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id, home_score FROM sb.matches),
agg AS (SELECT team_name, count(*) matchs, sum(ga) buts_encaisses, sum(ga)::numeric/count(*) encaisses_par_match FROM t JOIN sb.teams USING(team_id) GROUP BY team_name)
SELECT * FROM agg WHERE encaisses_par_match = (SELECT min(encaisses_par_match) FROM agg)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_matchs_tirs_au_but FROM sb.matches m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sb.events e WHERE e.match_id = m.match_id AND e.period = 5)

WITH buts AS (
  SELECT e.period FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.shots s ON s.event_id=e.event_id WHERE s.outcome='Goal' AND e.period<>5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.period FROM sb.events e WHERE e.type='Own Goal Against'
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE period=1) AS buts_1re_periode, count(*) AS buts_total,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE period=1)::numeric/count(*) AS part
FROM buts

SELECT p.player_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pa.goal_assist) AS passes_decisives
FROM sb.players p
LEFT JOIN sb.events e ON e.player_id = p.player_id AND e.type='Pass' AND e.period <> 5
LEFT JOIN sb.passes pa ON pa.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE p.player_name ILIKE '%hazard%'
GROUP BY p.player_name
SELECT count(*) AS passes_en_profondeur_reussies FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = p.event_id WHERE p.is_through_ball AND p.outcome IS NULL AND e.period <> 5

WITH c AS (SELECT e.player_id, count(*) n FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.passes p ON p.event_id=e.event_id WHERE p.outcome IS NULL AND e.period<>5 GROUP BY e.player_id)
SELECT pl.player_name, c.n AS passes_reussies FROM c JOIN sb.players pl USING(player_id) WHERE c.n = (SELECT max(n) FROM c)
SELECT count(*) AS penalties_tires, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome='Goal') AS marques FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id=s.event_id WHERE s.shot_type='Penalty' AND e.period<>5

WITH c AS (
  SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, away_score AS conceded FROM sb.matches
  UNION ALL
  SELECT away_team_id, home_score FROM sb.matches
), t AS (
  SELECT t.team_name, SUM(conceded) AS buts_encaisses, COUNT(*) AS matchs
  FROM c JOIN sb.teams t USING (team_id) GROUP BY t.team_name
)
SELECT team_name, buts_encaisses, matchs FROM t
WHERE buts_encaisses = (SELECT MAX(buts_encaisses) FROM t)

SELECT t.team_name, count(*) AS possessions_avec_tir, (SELECT count(*) FROM sb.possessions p2 WHERE p2.team_id = t.team_id AND p2.period <> 5) AS possessions_totales FROM sb.possessions p JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = p.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'Belgium' AND p.produced_shot AND p.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name

  SELECT home_team_id team_id, (home_score>away_score)::int w FROM sb.matches WHERE stage='Group Stage'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT away_team_id, (away_score>home_score)::int FROM sb.matches WHERE stage='Group Stage'
)
SELECT t.team_name, count(*) matchs, sum(w) victoires
FROM r JOIN sb.teams t USING(team_id)
GROUP BY t.team_name HAVING sum(w)=0 ORDER BY t.team_name

WITH t AS (SELECT p.player_name, count(*) AS tirs_cadres FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id=s.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id=e.player_id WHERE s.outcome IN ('Goal','Saved') AND e.period<>5 GROUP BY p.player_name)
SELECT * FROM t WHERE tirs_cadres=(SELECT max(tirs_cadres) FROM t)

WITH s AS (
  SELECT e.match_id, e.team_id FROM sb.shots sh JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = sh.event_id WHERE e.period <> 5
), c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN s.team_id = m.home_team_id THEN m.away_team_id ELSE m.home_team_id END AS team_id, count(*) AS tirs_concedes
  FROM s JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id = s.match_id GROUP BY 1
), mp AS (
  SELECT team_id, count(*) AS matchs FROM (SELECT home_team_id team_id FROM sb.matches UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id FROM sb.matches) x GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t.team_name, c.tirs_concedes, mp.matchs, c.tirs_concedes::numeric/mp.matchs AS tirs_concedes_par_match
FROM c JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id=c.team_id JOIN mp ON mp.team_id=c.team_id
ORDER BY c.tirs_concedes DESC

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS nb_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id=s.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id=e.player_id WHERE e.player_id=3009 AND e.period<>5 GROUP BY p.player_name

SELECT count(*) AS nb_tirs, (SELECT count(*) FROM sb.matches) AS nb_matchs, count(*)::numeric/(SELECT count(*) FROM sb.matches) AS tirs_par_match FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e USING(event_id) WHERE e.period <> 5

SELECT count(DISTINCT (l->'player'->>'id')::int) AS nb_joueurs
FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.details->'tactics'->'lineup') l
WHERE e.type = 'Starting XI' AND t.team_name = 'France'

SELECT CASE WHEN m.home_score > m.away_score THEN h.team_name ELSE a.team_name END AS vainqueur, h.team_name AS equipe_1, m.home_score AS score_1, m.away_score AS score_2, a.team_name AS equipe_2
FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams h ON h.team_id = m.home_team_id JOIN sb.teams a ON a.team_id = m.away_team_id
WHERE m.stage = 'Final'

WITH r AS (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name='Russia'),
m AS (
 SELECT m.match_id, m.stage, m.home_score, m.away_score, (m.home_team_id=r.team_id) AS home,
  (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.team_id=r.team_id) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.team_id<>r.team_id)
   FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.shots s USING(event_id) WHERE e.match_id=m.match_id AND e.period=5 AND s.outcome='Goal') AS tab_diff,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sb.events e WHERE e.match_id=m.match_id AND e.period=5) AS tab
 FROM sb.matches m, r WHERE r.team_id IN (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id))
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (home AND home_score>away_score) OR (NOT home AND away_score>home_score)) AS victoires_sur_le_terrain,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE home_score=away_score AND tab AND tab_diff>0) AS victoires_aux_tab,
 count(*) AS matchs_joues
FROM m
